recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further FHIR-core work is needed for this issue unless a future Group target-list edit removes RelatedPerson or adds Person contrary to the resolved scope.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asked to add Patient, Person, and RelatedPerson as Group.member.entity targets for family, household, SDOH, and payer use cases. The final resolution narrowed the change to adding RelatedPerson because Patient was already present and Person was not allowed as this kind of Reference target.
initial_application: Commit 437ca7d6a01f5b5e580ba0f8ad596dabcb2aa4ef explicitly applied FHIR-30767 by adding the RelatedPerson target profile to source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists group=Group, so source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml is current build input. FHIR-I minutes from 2021-02-01 match the Jira decision. FHIR-33196, already audited on the combined branch, confirms that RelatedPerson was the R4B target addition referenced by the ballot-change correction.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current Group.member.entity target list already includes RelatedPerson and Patient and does not include Person, matching the final FHIR-30767 resolution.

related_jiras.note: A later Published technical correction to the R4B ballot change list confirmed that Group.member.entity added RelatedPerson rather than Group; it is already represented on the combined branch.
